summary: Major restructure retest. Backend: rewrote /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py for v2 API — 47/47 PASSED, 1 SKIPPED (test_patch_synced_forbidden requires direct DB write to set is_synced=true, code path verified via review). Coverage: /api/auth/login + /api/auth/admin-login, /api/auth/register RETURNS 404 (confirmed removed), /api/admin/penjahit CRUD (create-name/PIN validation, list, PATCH tim/active/pin, deactivate blocks login with 403, DELETE), /api/admin/admins CRUD (create with username/password validation, list, self-delete forbidden, last-admin protection via delete other), /api/master-data (auth required, shape kode_produksi/tahapan_by_produk/aktivitas_lain/tim, tim auto-upsert on penjahit create), /api/records (create utama with lain_list, invalid time 400, lain out-of-range 400, overlap 400, istirahat 200, istirahat-2x 400, PATCH persistence via GET, delete other-user 404, delete own 200, admin delete-any 200), /api/admin/records (RBAC 403 for penjahit, tim+tanggal filter), /api/admin/summary (aggregate keys total_records/total_menit_utama/total_menit_lain/total_output/per_penjahit), /api/admin/sheet-config (GET returns configured, POST rejects invalid JSON 400 and missing client_email/private_key 400), /api/admin/sync-records + /api/admin/sync-master (RBAC 403 for penjahit). Frontend (mobile 390x844): Login shows Nama+PIN only, no 'Daftar Baru' tab, no 'admin/admin123' hint, has 'Masuk sebagai Admin' link → admin-login. Admin login → /admin/dashboard renders NavChips (Penjahit/Admin/Sync Master/Settings) + filter-tanggal/filter-tim + btn-sync. /admin/penjahit-mgmt: created UITest_1786209697 tailor via UI (POST 200, appears in list). /admin/admin-mgmt loads with btn-add. Penjahit login → beranda shows greeting + stats + Shift info + Tambah Inputan Khusus (Pre-Shift) card + collapsed cards area + Tambah Lembur Malam (Post-Shift) card + Input Pekerjaan Reguler & Istirahat buttons + 'Selesaikan Input Reguler Hari Ini' inspection. Tab bar has safe-area bottom padding. form-record opens with Kode Produksi dropdown (empty since master not synced), Tahapan disabled 'Pilih Kode Produksi dulu', Aktivitas Lain section with Tambah button.

react_native_issues.issue: Console error observed after penjahit login: 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>.' Some raw text/whitespace is being rendered directly inside a View instead of a <Text>. Likely candidates: beranda.tsx or form-record.tsx conditional-render blocks with stray whitespace/expression. Non-blocking but should be fixed for web compat. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/beranda.tsx and /app/frontend/app/form-record.tsx

Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Coming from a dependency (likely expo-router or a modal wrapper) — not app code. Non-blocking; watch for a library upgrade.

action_items: Find and fix stray text child of <View> in beranda.tsx or form-record.tsx (search for `{cond && ' '}` or trailing spaces inside JSX outside <Text>).
(Optional) Track down pointerEvents deprecated warning source; upgrade dep or wrap style.pointerEvents.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /api/records PATCH correctly blocks is_synced=true (line 482-483) but tests could not directly force is_synced=true via API without adding an admin-only mark endpoint or direct DB access — verified only via code review.
_purge_synced runs on every GET /api/records (line 502) — this is fine but could be moved to a background scheduler if request latency becomes a concern.
Shift enforcement is intentionally frontend-only (utils/shift.ts). Backend does NOT validate shift bounds — matches spec (non-blocking warning). Confirmed.
server.py: SHEET_HEADERS + _record_to_rows correctly duplicate the utama row per aktivitas_lain, producing 1 row per lain (spec compliant). Cannot exercise without valid GSheet credentials.
Backend uses env vars for MONGO_URL/DB_NAME/JWT_SECRET (with fallback) — good. Consider removing JWT_SECRET fallback in production.

server.py: seed_data only seeds admin + DEFAULT_LAIN. Kode Produksi + Tahapan Standar come only from sync-master (GSheet). If admin never configures GSheet, form-record dropdowns will be empty (spec-compliant but worth surfacing in UI as 'admin belum sinkron master data').
